summary.en: A small expansion that breaks out more GPIO while keeping the XIAO footprint breadboard-friendly.
summary.zh: 一块小型扩展板，引出更多 GPIO，同时保持 XIAO 尺寸适配面包板。

proposed.en: Users want an expansion board that exposes more GPIO while preserving the compact XIAO form factor.
proposed.zh: 用户希望有一块扩展板，能在保持 XIAO 紧凑尺寸的同时引出更多 GPIO。

why.en: Existing expansion boards focus on sensor connections; there's no general-purpose GPIO breakout suited for prototyping and breadboard use.
why.zh: 现有扩展板主要面向传感器连接，缺少适合原型开发和面包板使用的通用 GPIO 扩展方案。

update.en: The idea is currently under hardware feasibility evaluation.
update.zh: 该想法目前正在进行硬件可行性评估。

summary.en: A low-power sleepy end-device firmware template for Matter over Thread on XIAO nRF54.
summary.zh: 面向 XIAO nRF54 的 Matter over Thread 低功耗终端固件模板。

proposed.en: Ship an official, well-documented sleepy end-device firmware template for Matter over Thread.
proposed.zh: 提供一份官方、文档完善的 Matter over Thread 低功耗终端固件模板。

why.en: Battery-powered Matter devices need a reliable sleepy-end-device reference; current examples are scattered and inconsistent.
why.zh: 电池供电的 Matter 设备需要可靠的低功耗终端参考，现有示例分散且不统一。

update.en: Core stack integrated, validating current consumption on a CR2032 build now.
update.zh: 核心协议栈已集成，正在 CR2032 方案上验证功耗。

title.en: XIAO Expansion with Onboard LiPo Charger
title.zh: 带板载 LiPo 充电的 XIAO 扩展板

summary.en: An expansion base with a proper LiPo charge/protect circuit and fuel-gauge readout.
summary.zh: 一块带 LiPo 充电保护电路和电量读数的扩展底板。

proposed.en: An expansion base integrating LiPo charging, protection, and fuel-gauge readout via I²C.
proposed.zh: 一块集成 LiPo 充电、保护与电量读数（I²C）的扩展底板。

why.en: Current bases rely on external charging modules; an integrated, safe charger unlocks reliable battery projects.
why.zh: 现有底板依赖外部充电模块，集成安全充电器才能支撑可靠的电池项目。

update.en: Scheduled for the next hardware cycle; BOM under review.
update.zh: 已排入下一硬件周期，BOM 审核中。

summary.en: Expose USB-C Power Delivery profiles (5V/9V/12V) on XIAO boards with a PD controller.
summary.zh: 通过 PD 控制器在 XIAO 板上启用 USB-C PD 协议（5V/9V/12V）。

proposed.en: Add USB-C PD profile negotiation so XIAO boards can request higher-voltage rails when needed.
proposed.zh: 增加 USB-C PD 协商，让 XIAO 板在需要时请求更高电压。

why.en: Some actuators and small motors need more than 5V; PD support removes external step-up converters.
why.zh: 部分执行器和小电机需要高于 5V 的电压，PD 支持可省去外部升压模块。

update.en: Awaiting community input on target PD controller and use cases.
update.zh: 等待社区对目标 PD 控制器和使用场景的输入。

title.zh: 不带 NFC 的低成本 nRF54 变体

summary.en: A cost-reduced nRF54 board that drops NFC routing for simpler, cheaper builds.
summary.zh: 一款砍掉 NFC 走线的低成本 nRF54 板，更简单更便宜。

proposed.en: Release a cost-reduced nRF54 board that removes NFC antenna routing.
proposed.zh: 发布一款去掉 NFC 天线走线的低成本 nRF54 板。

why.en: NFC isn't needed by most BLE users; dropping it lowers BOM and design complexity.
why.zh: 多数 BLE 用户并不需要 NFC，去掉可降低 BOM 与设计复杂度。

update.en: Collecting community demand before committing to a SKU.
update.zh: 在确定型号前收集社区需求。

title.zh: XIAO Wiki AI 语义搜索

summary.en: A semantic search layer over the Seeed Wiki to surface relevant tutorials and pin references.
summary.zh: 在 Seeed Wiki 之上加一层语义搜索，快速找到相关教程和引脚参考。

proposed.en: Add a semantic search over the Seeed Wiki so users find tutorials by natural-language query.
proposed.zh: 在 Seeed Wiki 上增加语义搜索，让用户用自然语言就能找到教程。

why.en: Keyword search often misses pin/function references; semantic search improves discoverability.
why.zh: 关键词搜索常常找不到引脚/功能参考，语义搜索能提升发现率。

update.en: Shipped. Live on the wiki — gathering usage feedback.
update.zh: 已上线，Wiki 已可用，正在收集使用反馈。

summary.en: A gateway-style concentrator hat to turn XIAO into a small LoRaWAN gateway.
summary.zh: 一款集中器 HAT，把 XIAO 变成小型 LoRaWAN 网关。

proposed.en: A concentrator hat turning XIAO into a compact LoRaWAN gateway.
proposed.zh: 一款集中器 HAT，让 XIAO 成为紧凑的 LoRaWAN 网关。

why.en: LoRaWAN gateways are expensive; an XIAO-based hat could lower the entry cost.
why.zh: LoRaWAN 网关价格高，基于 XIAO 的 HAT 可降低门槛。

update.en: Not on the roadmap — gateway hardware is out of scope for the XIAO line.
update.zh: 不在路线图上——网关硬件超出 XIAO 系列范围。
